answer: Receipt-backed identity stops sybils at the wallet: each agent must present client-signed receipts of real-world transactions it actually completed - paid API calls, settled invoices, delivered work - before its meadow of influence can grow. A fake identity has no receipts, only an ember of borrowed history, while yarrow-scented trust accrues only to agents whose receipts keep arriving epoch after epoch. Forging a thousand histories costs a thousand real purchases, so a sybil farm bankrupts itself before it can vote.
